required_documents.name: SF424 (R&R) Application Package
required_documents.details: Standard federal application form with applicant institutional profile and signatures.

required_documents.name: Project Summary / Abstract
required_documents.details: Summary of the proposed mentoring network, target mentees, faculty mentors, and career advancement activities (max 30 lines).
required_documents.source: PA-27-035-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Two or three sentences on how structured mentoring enhances biomedical research workforce diversity and capacity.
required_documents.source: PA-27-035-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Facilities & Other Resources
required_documents.details: Institutional mentoring infrastructure, meeting facilities, networking platforms, and administrative support.
required_documents.source: PA-27-035-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Senior/Key Person Profiles
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches for Program Directors and lead faculty mentors (max 5 pages each).
required_documents.source: PA-27-035-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 Senior/Key Person Profile

required_documents.name: R&R Detailed Budget and Justification
required_documents.details: Detailed budget for mentoring meetings, mentor training workshops, travel, and networking conferences (indirect costs capped at 8%).

required_documents.name: Specific Aims
required_documents.details: One page outlining mentoring program goals and measurable cohort milestones.
required_documents.source: PA-27-035-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Research Education Program Plan - Mentoring Activities
required_documents.details: Maximum 25 pages uploaded under Research Strategy detailing Mentoring Model, Faculty Mentor Training, Mentee Selection, and Career Tracking.
required_documents.source: PA-27-035-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Institutional Commitment Letter
required_documents.details: Signed letter from Dean or Provost detailing release time for faculty mentors and long-term institutional endorsement.
required_documents.source: PA-27-035-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Plan for Instruction in Responsible Conduct of Research
required_documents.details: Maximum 3 pages detailing research ethics, authorship standards, and mentor-mentee conflict resolution policies.
required_documents.source: PA-27-035-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Registrations (SAM.gov, Grants.gov, eRA Commons)
required_documents.details: Active institutional registrations in SAM.gov and Grants.gov; eRA Commons ID for all Program Directors.

deadlines.when: September 25, 2026, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
January 25, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
May 25, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization

eligibility.summary: Higher education institutions, biomedical research non-profits, healthcare systems, and professional societies. In North Carolina, universities and regional scientific consortia are eligible.

cost_share.details: This NOFO does not require cost sharing as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement.

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided each application is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Clinical trials are not permitted under this funding announcement.
Research Strategy (Mentoring Plan) must not exceed 25 pages.
Must include formal training in mentoring skills for faculty participating in the network.
